context: Current name generator wizard is broken — fields are unusable and the flow is not calling Claude. Full redesign required. Wireframe completed in Cowork session 2026-04-29. See UXREVIEW.md for current site issues. Build proceeds in goal order below.

phases.name: question_ui
phases.description: Replace the current 8-field wizard form with a card-based question flow. 5 questions only. Q1: product description (textarea). Q2: brand feel (visual option cards: Bold/Friendly/Minimal/Premium/Technical/Playful, pick up to 3). Q3: name length (Short 1-5 / Medium 6-9 / Any). Q4: preferred starting sounds (chips, optional). Q5: words/sounds to avoid (chips, optional). No session name field on this step — auto-generate it from the product description. Frontend only, no backend changes. File: frontend/src/pages/new-session.js renderStep2NameGenerator().
acceptance: all 5 questions are tap/click only except Q1
Q1 textarea is the only free text input
Continue button disabled until Q1 has content

phases.name: word_cloud_generation
phases.description: New backend endpoint POST /api/sessions/:id/wordcloud. Accepts the questionnaire payload. Calls Claude (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) with a prompt that extracts 15-25 seed concepts from the answers, tagged by tier (core/secondary/style). Returns JSON: {words:[{word:string,tier:0|1|2}]}. Stores result in session metadata. Frontend renders the matrix word cloud (falling kana/latin character rain with seed words overlaid, tier-colored, pulsing). User can click words to remove them. Removed words are tracked in state. Worker file: backend/worker/src/runners/wordcloud.js. Route wired in index.js.
acceptance: endpoint returns words array with tier tags
click-to-remove works and persists in state
removed words excluded from fuzzing payload

phases.name: name_fuzzing_engine
phases.description: Pure JS fuzzing module, no external deps. Input: array of seed words + removed list + preferences (length, start sounds, avoid). Output: array of ~1000-1400 unique candidate strings. Operations to implement: (1) vowel_swap — replace each vowel with all other vowels e.g. flow->flaw,fliw,flow,flew,flaw. (2) drop_ending — strip last 1-2 chars if result >=3 chars. (3) add_suffix — append each of [io,ai,ly,hub,lab,hq,camp,app,go,ify,fy,x] to each word. (4) compress — remove vowels from interior e.g. order->ordr, serve->srv. (5) expand — add vowel between consonant clusters. (6) blend_pairs — take first half of word A + second half of word B for all pairs (max 200 blends). (7) x_prefix — replace leading vowel or first syllable with x e.g. expansive->xpansiv. Deduplicate output. Filter: min 3 chars, max 14 chars, no numeric-only, apply avoid_words list. File: backend/worker/src/lib/fuzzer.js. Unit tests required in tests/unit/fuzzer.test.js.
acceptance: fuzzer produces 800-1400 candidates from 15 seed words
unit tests cover each operation and edge cases

phases.name: bulk_availability_pipeline
phases.description: New orchestration layer that runs all fuzzer candidates through existing check runners. Input: array of ~1200 candidate names + session_id. Must not block the worker — use async batching. Batch size: 50 names per tick, 200ms delay between batches to avoid rate limits. For each name run: domain_availability (check .com and .io only for speed), social_handles (X and Instagram only for speed), trademark (stub OK for now). Each result written to D1 as a candidate_result row: (session_id, name, domain_com, domain_io, social_x, social_ig, trademark_status, checked_at). Progress trackable via GET /api/sessions/:id/candidates/progress which returns {total, checked, complete:bool}. File: backend/worker/src/runners/bulk_check.js. New D1 table: candidate_results.
acceptance: bulk check runs without timing out worker
domain and social checks actually fire (not stubbed)

phases.name: scoring_and_ranking
phases.description: Scoring algorithm run after bulk check completes. Score 0-100 per candidate. Weights: domain_com_available=30pts, domain_io_available=10pts, social_x_available=15pts, social_ig_available=15pts, trademark_clear=20pts, length_match_preference=5pts, no_avoid_words=5pts. Bonus: +5 if all four main checks clear. Penalty: -10 if trademark=conflict (not just possible). Store score in candidate_results.score column. Rank by score desc. Expose GET /api/sessions/:id/candidates?limit=200&offset=0 returning top results sorted by score. Also-rans bucket: candidates scoring 40-59 stored separately for the report tail section. File: backend/worker/src/lib/scorer.js.
acceptance: unit tests for scorer with known inputs

phases.name: results_ui
phases.description: Three new frontend views replacing the current name_candidates report card. (1) Generating screen — counter animating from 0 to total candidate count, three columns of scrolling name strings (slot-machine style). Shown while bulk_check is running. Polls /candidates/progress every 2s. (2) Results list screen — ranked cards showing name, score, 4 status pills (domain/TM/social/app). Sort controls (best score / domain first / shortest). Also-rans section collapsed at bottom. (3) Name detail screen — full breakdown: all domain variants, all social handles, TM closest match, app store. Back button returns to list. PDF export available on detail screen. All three screens are sub-views of the existing session detail page, rendered when session_type=name_generator and a candidates report exists. File: frontend/src/pages/session.js (extend existing render logic).
acceptance: generating animation plays while pipeline runs
name detail shows all check data
also-rans section visible at list bottom

phases.name: question_to_session_wiring
phases.description: Wire the full flow end to end. User completes 5 questions -> POST /api/sessions creates session -> POST /api/sessions/:id/wordcloud fires -> frontend shows matrix word cloud -> user clicks Generate -> POST /api/sessions/:id/fuzz fires (runs fuzzer + bulk_check + scorer async) -> frontend polls progress -> results render. The fuzz endpoint returns immediately with {status:running} and the pipeline runs via ctx.waitUntil(). Session status field used to track state: draft->wordcloud->generating->complete. Frontend polls session status to drive screen transitions. No page reloads.
acceptance: full flow runs end to end without manual URL changes
ctx.waitUntil used correctly so worker returns fast
error states handled at each step
flow works from prefill= URL param too

db_changes: ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN generator_status TEXT DEFAULT NULL

CREATE TABLE candidate_results (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, domain_com INTEGER DEFAULT 0, domain_io INTEGER DEFAULT 0, social_x INTEGER DEFAULT 0, social_ig INTEGER DEFAULT 0, trademark_status TEXT DEFAULT NULL, score INTEGER DEFAULT 0, bucket TEXT DEFAULT NULL, checked_at INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id))
CREATE INDEX idx_candidate_results_session_score ON candidate_results(session_id, score DESC)

notes.word_cloud_matrix: Wireframe uses falling kana/latin character rain (matrix style) with seed words overlaid as glowing colored text. Core words green tier-0, secondary teal tier-1, style signals blue tier-2. Click to remove. See Cowork session 2026-04-29 for interactive wireframe.
notes.scoring_rationale: Domain .com weighted highest because it is the clearest user-facing trust signal. Trademark weighted 20pts because a conflict is a hard blocker. Social handles split across two platforms rather than all five to keep bulk check fast — full social sweep runs only on the top 50 results post-ranking.
